data.name: Hang Out
data.detailed_description:
Hang Out is a horror visual novel that combines narrative storytelling with with multiple gameplay elements. If you enjoy Silent Hill-style storytelling, as well as dark mysteries that gradually unravel their truth, this is an experience worth stepping into.

You awaken in an abandoned club, having lost an important part of your memory. The strange remnants scattered throughout the city, a figure who feels inexplicably familiar, and the deep sea floating above the sky all draw you further and further inward. As your investigation deepens, you begin to realize that this is not a disaster unrelated to you. The past you are trying to recover may in fact be the very cause of the catastrophe itself.

In the search for the truth, you will encounter one disturbing event after another, explore a variety of locations, and navigate the conflicting motives of different factions. As more and more secrets are uncovered, you will gradually come to understand the desires and beliefs hidden behind this disaster, as well as a past that has never truly come to an end

data.short_description: Hang Out is a visual novel with multiple gameplay elements. You awaken in a bizarre town ruled by the “Sea of the Sky,” guided by a familiar yet unreadable figure. As residents mutate and factions clash, you uncover buried memories and a truth meant to stay forgotten

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz Dual-Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display recommended

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains adult and disturbing content, including scenes of masturbation, explicit sexual descriptions, violence and gore, as well as text descriptions involving abuse. The game also includes occasional depictions of bodily harm, corpses, and death. This content is intended for adult players only.
